name: Portugal

pet.recycling_rate: SOURCE: plastic packaging recycled in Portugal: 39.5% in 2023 (Eurostat env_waspacr, counted at the input to recycling) and 51.5% in 2024 (APA, SIGRE management report 2024, counted at sorting); no separate PET bottle figure yet, the deposit system for single use bottles was licensed in 2024. Prior centred between the two figures

aluminium.recycling_rate: SOURCE: 19.2% of aluminium packaging recycled in Portugal in 2024, 18.5% in 2023 (APA, SIGRE management report 2024 and 2023); the figure covers all aluminium packaging and there is no deposit system yet, so the prior is wide
pet.incineration_share: SOURCE: municipal waste in Portugal in 2022: 20% incinerated, 55% landfilled, 30% recycled (EEA country profile 2025, Eurostat env_wasmun), so about 27% of what is not recycled is incinerated

glass.end_of_life.source: SOURCE: 51.8% of glass packaging recycled in Portugal in 2024, 50.4% in 2023 (APA, SIGRE management report 2024 and 2023); the rest follows municipal waste, 55% landfilled and 20% incinerated in 2022 (EEA country profile 2025)

liquid_packaging_board.recycling_rate: SOURCE: 38% of beverage cartons recycled in Portugal in 2022, about 10 kt (Tetra Pak, under its voluntary agreement with Sociedade Ponto Verde); APA allocates cartons to paper, plastic and aluminium and publishes no separate rate, and Zero Waste Europe estimates carton rates below the industry figures, so the prior is wide
pet.recycled_content: SOURCE: 24% average recycled content in PET beverage bottles in the EU in 2022 (PET Market in Europe: State of Play, Plastics Recyclers Europe, UNESDA, NMWE, Petcore Europe and ICIS, 2024); Directive (EU) 2019/904 requires 25% from 2025 and 30% from 2030
